comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that the sequence of the peptide shows 92.9% similarity to Dermaseptin-B4. 14% V, L, A, 17% K, and 10% N. Mol Wt: 3025.595; GRAVY: -0.064; mol formula: C135H234N35O38S1. Activity: Active against S. aureus MRSA (MIC 4-8 uM), E. coli (MIC 4 uM) and C. albicans (MIC 4 uM), P. aeruginosa (MIC 8 uM), K. pneumoniae (MIC 8 uM), and E.faecalis (MIC 128 uM). MBC can much higher. Horse blood RBC: HC50 114.7 uM, not hemo.lytic. Structure: Helical in 50% TFE. In vitro Toxicity: no anti-proliferative activity against all five human cancer cell lines and normal human HMEC-1 cells at 100 uM. Updated 7/2021

comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that the sequence of the peptide shows 96.4% similarity to Dermaseptin-DI2. 14% L and K, 21% A and 10% N. Mol Wt: 2912.439; GRAVY: 0.15; mol formula: C129H223N34O37S1. Activity: Active against S. aureus MRSA (MIC 4 uM) and E. coli (MIC 4 uM) and C. albicans (MIC 4 uM). DRS-DU-1 was twofold more potent against K. pneumoniae (MIC 4 uM), P. aeruginosa (MIC 4 uM) and E. faecalis (MIC 64 uM) than DRS-CA-1. In vitro Toxicity: horse RBC: HC50 216 uM, hemo.lytic. Also had a selective effect on cancer cells (H157 and PC-3, IC50 8.43 and 21.6 uM), also come toxicity to normal HMEC-1 cells (HC50 53.75 uM). Structure: Helical in 50% TFE. Updated 7/2021
